BJP Leader and Family Accused of Crypto Investment Scam

A BJP leader and his family are accused of a cryptocurrency investment scam worth ₹1.08 crore in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh. The police have registered a case against five individuals, including the BJP leader and his wife. The incident has raised questions about the use of cryptocurrency for financial gain.
